marta (support): Escalation from AcmePay — they created an API key in the dashboard this morning but all calls return 401 invalid_api_key. Key appears as Active in the UI.

sam (AcmePay): Repro steps I ran: 
```
curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_demo_7bX3\" https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat/completions -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```
Response: 401 {\"error\":\"invalid_api_key\", \"message\":\"key not found\"}
I created the key from the self-serve signup > API keys page around 09:12 local.

marta (support): Thanks — can you paste the key id (the short suffix) and the org name? Also did you by any chance use the "Try demo" button earlier in the flow?

sam (AcmePay): Key suffix: demo_7bX3, org: acmepay-inc. We did click "Try demo" briefly then created the key from Settings > API keys. Not sure if that matters.

marta (support): @ryan (eng-oncall) tagging since UI shows Active but requests failing. Can you check account key metadata and whether demo keys have TTL/preview flags? :eyes:

support-bot: Created internal ticket #SR-789012 and attached logs.

ryan (eng-oncall): Looking. From admin logs for org=acmepay-inc key=demo_7bX3 I see: 
```
metadata: {created_by: signup-flow, type: preview_demo, expires_at: 1768130200}
status: active (UI), backend_state: expired
```
Backend rejected token after expiry check, UI shows Active because frontend glosses preview keys into the list without expiry badge (bug).

marta (support): Ok that explains mismatch — frontend bug shows preview keys as Active. The token was a demo/preview key with a 2 hour TTL created during signup and it expired at 1768130200 (about 08:30 UTC).

sam (AcmePay): Huh — we assumed dashboard-created keys were permanent. Is there a way to tell which keys are preview?

ryan (eng-oncall): We should have an "expires" column; filing a console bug. In the short term you can tell by prefix: preview/demo keys start with sk_demo_. Permanent keys start with sk_live_ (or created from Org > API keys > Create key). Also run this admin check if you want: `admin keys describe --org acmepay-inc demo_7bX3` (internal only).

marta (support): Sam — quick remediation: create a new key from Settings > API keys > Create key (choose Org key). Use that sk_live_ key in your app. I'll keep SR-789012 open until you confirm calls succeed.

sam (AcmePay): Created a new sk_live_8kY9 now, retried the curl and it works: 200. Thanks.

marta (support): Great — closing loop: root cause = preview/demo key with short TTL created from signup flow, UI incorrectly labeled as Active. Action items: (1) console team to show expiry/preview badge (ticket filed), (2) docs to call out prefix convention, (3) support KB updated with how to identify preview keys (linked in SR). Closing once SR-789012 acknowledged. :white_check_mark:
